scope: Repository integration and isolated runtime verification; no production deployment or production credentials generated.

pkiSmoke.source: Actual evaluated Clan generator.script, executed via bash -eu with temporary in/out directories and declared OpenSSL runtimeInputs.
checksPassed: CA with insufficient remaining lifetime rejected

passedScenarios.name: one node schedules and both builders hold a WorkerSession on it
balancer auth: client cert, bearer token, nothing, unknown CN
DAG build is scheduled across workers and lands in the cache
repeat is answered Cached by the scheduler without building
inputs already in the cache are not sent to the scheduler
outputs read back through any worker carry the cache signature
two clients wanting the same drv build it once
--timeout and --max-silent-time reach the builder
the first client leaving does not fail the second
build hook: nix-daemon with builders = grpc://lb
an input only one worker has still reaches the builder
upload whose reference the worker lacks is completed from the cache
a niks3 restart does not cost the leader its role
scheduler down: the other node takes the lock and keeps it
clean scheduler restart: peers are told, running builds survive, no reconnect noise
scheduler restart mid-build: build finishes, no double build
interrupting the client stops the build on the worker
a deploy mid-build drains: the build finishes, the new generation takes over
queue gauges show a burst while every build blocks
requiredSystemFeatures: placed on the worker that has them, refused when none does
low disk drains a worker and builds go to the other

farmSmoke.scopeDifference: Reused the complete pinned upstream farm scenario with the exact fleet Nix and packaged plugin, and explicitly pinned Niks3 server. The fixture includes OIDC and two schedulers; production admits exact mTLS identities and has only one scheduler. This is not evidence of production HA or live host activation.
